featureRule: Features describe the candidate at its decision-point revision only. Later evidence is used solely for oracle disposition.

cases.candidate: Agent Semantic Core v0 as a reusable semantic kernel
cases.codingNotes: Live dogfood established Effect/Dispatch/Unknown/evidence semantics, but no second materially different consumer had shown the whole kernel needed independent authority. The candidate bundled several durable invariants with implementation/package choices.
cases.oracleNote: Effect uncertainty/evidence responsibilities survive; Semantic Core is not an active Core/product layer.

cases.candidate: Minimum durable semantic state for open-work continuation across process/model replacement
cases.codingNotes: Frozen continuation workload and fresh Host/model replacement show session/transcript identity is insufficient; the experiment explicitly avoids a generic Memory product and binds state to work/world owners.
cases.oracleNote: CR-02 retains open-work identity/continuity while general Memory runtime is deleted.

cases.candidate: Harness-owned Temporal Cognitive Graph / Working Set as durable cognitive structure
cases.codingNotes: The question itself states construction is blocked and requires transcript+compaction/retrieval to fail first. Benefits remain hypotheses tied partly to current cognition limits.
cases.oracleNote: TCG loses an active responsibility slot and its long derivation moves to Git archaeology.

cases.candidate: Owner-native read-only Observation contract + bounded reconstruction semantics
cases.codingNotes: Host/Harness/Runtime owner-native histories plus B3/B4 reconstruction/evaluation require exact joining while the projection remains explicitly non-authoritative and rebuildable.
cases.oracleNote: CR-09 retains owner-native observation projection while Plane/daemon/shadow authority is contracted.

cases.candidate: Global Agent-first research method/checker as durable Computing mechanism
cases.codingNotes: The method has a first consumer and strong process boundaries, but the global machine-readable method/checker is broader than any single experiment requires and duplicates local experiment declarations.
cases.oracleNote: The durable experiment discipline survives as CR-17, while the 784-line global method/checker is later replaced by a 122-line experiment-local contract/checker.

cases.candidate: Agent-first Infrastructure Promotion Rule as a reusable meta-selection prior
cases.codingNotes: At freeze time this is a decision rule synthesized from prior reform evidence, not yet independently consumed by A0/ACS. It deliberately lacks direct product authority and includes reopen/deletion pressure.
cases.oracleNote: The rule remains canonical and is independently consumed by A0 and later surface/equipment/capability work.

cases.codingNotes: Evaluation and Security independently need exact environment identity, but the real common contract is unproven; Evaluation schema leaks domain fields and Security side is still contract-shaped evidence.
cases.oracleNote: Shared problem is retained, global contract is not promoted; owner manifests plus opaque bindings remain preferred.

cases.codingNotes: Harness, Runtime and domains already own materially different measurements. The demonstrated missing layer is projection/provenance, not a new writable fact owner.
cases.oracleNote: Owner-native usage remains authoritative; only bounded read-only measurement projection survives.
